openClinicalQuestions: How does Dr. Zalak typically schedule and document the 3-month supervised PFMT review in WHD practice (in-person vs hybrid)?
Which local urgent pathways should the site name for suspected cauda equina-type red flags in Ahmedabad/Bangalore?

claimLedger.claim: Categorise UI as stress, mixed or urgency/OAB; offer supervised PFMT of at least 3 months as first-line for stress or mixed UI; confirm contraction digitally before supervised PFMT; continue exercises if beneficial; offer ≥6 weeks bladder training for urgency/mixed.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · NG123 Urinary incontinence and pelvic organ prolapse in women: management — Recommendations · not stated on Recommendations chapter fetch (NG123)
claimLedger.limitations: UK NICE pathway; Indian service structure and referral routes may differ.
